name: Recraft API
description: Hosted raster and true vector (SVG) generation, including icon-like styles; 1 USD = 1000 API units.

restrictions: Commercial usage terms not confirmed in the pricing page; read terms before shipping
Official MCP server repo recraft-ai/mcp-recraft-server is archived (MIT)
license.notes: No official JS SDK; OpenAI-compatible REST.

cost.notes: 2026-11-14: raster USD 0.007-0.04/image (V4.1 Flash V2 0.007); vector USD 0.05-0.08/image; no free tier listed.

verdictReason: Only mainstream API returning real SVG, a fit for tiny scalable icons; paid and BYOK/proxy.
